g.text: d Biomass: effect vs stress damage
Fig. 4. Stress-damage gradient (descriptive). Study means of ln(SB/S) against the stress damage D = ln(S/C) of the same study; lines: between-study
OLS, 95 % study-bootstrap CI in brackets; "artefact" = slope expected from the shared S arm alone (−mean var(S)/var(D)). Stronger damage goes with a
larger relative biostimulant gain, but part of the slope is a shared-arm artefact and the relation is between studies (not causal). D is known only
after the experiment, so it is used only as a conditional meta-regression moderator, never as an ML feature. Expected salinity loss: tomato threshold
2.5 dS/m, slope 9.9 %/dS/m (NaCl mM/10 as EC equivalent where EC is not printed). [V5 (2026-11-20)]
